instrument: Pulaski County high-intensity digital infrastructure ordinance (passed Sept 22, vetoed Sept 25, 2026)
summary: Quorum Court passed 11-4 with an emergency clause an ordinance classifying large data centers as heavy industrial uses requiring a conditional use permit, without grandfathering AVAIO Digital's Wrightsville campus. County Judge Barry Hyde vetoed it Sept 25; an override needs nine votes at the next regular meeting, reported as Oct 27.

source.citation: Arkansas Democrat-Gazette, Arkansas Times, KATV, FOX16 (Sept 25-26, 2026)

notes: CONFLICT: ordinance number reported as 26-I-56B, 25-OR-19 and 26-OR-19; AVAIO size reported as 150 MW initial vs more than 1 GW at build-out. Status 'proposed' used for a vetoed ordinance pending override. Forward calendar: Oct 27.  Ordinance numbers SETTLED by the veto letter: the letter uses both 26-OR-19 (subject line, closing) and 26-I-56B (first paragraph). "25-OR-19" in KATV coverage is an error.
confidence_note: Ordinance and veto letter not read; confirm number with the county clerk.
